newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower, activity fails to pick.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower, activity fails to pick.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index continued in familiar fashion on Tuesday edging slightly lower but failing to attract more than a small amount of interest from either domestic or foreign traders.
The PX50 dropped 0.26 percent to 504.7 but overall bourse turnover failed to exceed 500 million crowns.
"There's really not a lot to be said when it is this quiet," said one local dealer who requested anonymity.
"People are really just waiting for such things as the gross domestic product results on Thursday and general indications of imporvement in Czech ecnomy," he added.
One of the only new factors on the index on Tuesday was the return of CEZ which was suspended from trading ahead of its annual general meeting. CEZ lost six crowns to 895.
The index's two biggest banking stocks both fell. Komercni Banka dropped 32 crowns to 1,977 and Ceska Sporitelna declined five crowns to 299.
Construction stocks were almost all down.
